Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::modifyLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(t|t.LoantermID = self.termId)
	precondition:
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->exists(lt|lt.ID = termId)
	postcondition:
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(loanTerm) and
		loanTerm.Content = content and
		loanTerm.ID = termId and
		result = true
}
